tools.templatesDesc: Write, review, and prepare consistent responses in English and Albanian.
tools.noTemplates: No templates yet. Create a draft to start your response library.
tools.title: Title
tools.reviewRequired: Editing an approved template returns it to draft. An editor must review and approve it again.
tools.manualDistribution: Review the generated text before sharing it. Copying does not send or publish anything. Automated distribution and live translation are not connected.
tools.selectTemplate: Select a template to preview and fill it with a claim.
tools.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the preview text.
tools.migrationHint: If this is a new installation, apply the response tools database migration. Otherwise check your connection and permissions.
tools.alertsDesc: Assignments and updates from your investigations, in one place.
tools.inAppOnly: These preferences control in-app alerts. Email, SMS, and web push delivery are not connected.
tools.priorityFormula: Severity 50% + reach 30% + recency 20%. Recency fades over 7 days. This is a triage score, not a truth score.
tools.checklistNote: Editors manage tasks. Assigned analysts can complete their tasks. This checklist supports review and does not automatically approve a verdict.
tools.stepSource: Trace the original source and context
tools.stepReview: Request editorial review of the findings
tools.stepResponse: Prepare and review the public response
tools.analyticsDesc: Measure case volume, outcomes, and response priorities from your actual claims.
tools.resolutionTime: Average time to last update of resolved claims
tools.noActiveClaims: No active claims in this period.
tools.analyticsNote: The selected period filters claim creation dates. Time is measured from creation to the last update of currently resolved claims; it is not an audited first-resolution timestamp. Priority is a transparent heuristic, not ML campaign detection.
tools.servicesNote: Implementation status in this application, not a live provider health check. External services require server credentials and integration work. Never paste private API keys into browser settings.
tools.coreService: Authentication, database, realtime, and evidence storage.
tools.disinfoResource: External disinformation coverage from Sbunker. Opens on their website.
tools.feedService: Article import through the deployed crawler. A successful import still depends on the live function and source feed.
tools.translationService: UI translations are built in. Automated translation of content needs a separate API integration and review.
tools.deliveryService: Automated email and SMS require server-side adapters, credentials, delivery tracking, and recipient consent.
tools.teamService: Outbound team alerts require an approved webhook or bot integration.
tools.collectionService: Active content collection alternative with OAuth support.
tools.documentsService: Document research and sourcing API; no account is connected here.
tools.externalService: GitHub sign-in does not imply repository access. Publishing integrations need separate permissions.
tools.retiredService: Pocket shut down on 8 July 2025 and is not an integration target.
tools.codonCredit: in co-operation with CODON a part of Progon LLC.
tools.integrityPassed: SHA-256 matches the stored file hash
tools.integrityFailed: File hash does not match the stored fingerprint
tools.downloadFailed: Unable to retrieve the evidence file
tools.removeMetadata: Remove metadata from JPEG, PNG, and WebP images
tools.hashNote: SHA-256 fingerprints are stored for the original and uploaded file. Image redaction creates a PNG copy; preserve the original separately. Other formats are not sanitized. Maximum 50 MB.
tools.docsIntro: A practical guide to the tools available in this version.
tools.docsClaims: Record the source URL and context. Editors can set severity, reach, and an assignee from the claim checklist.
tools.docsEvidence: Attach evidence to a claim. New uploads receive SHA-256 fingerprints. Optional image metadata removal preserves a fingerprint of the original and stores a processed PNG.
tools.docsReview: Use the checklist to document your investigation. Editors review the evidence and update the claim status; checklist completion alone does not authorize publication.
tools.docsTemplates: Save a draft template in English or Albanian. An editor approves it. Choose a claim to fill placeholders, review the result, and copy it for manual distribution.
tools.docsAlerts: Your inbox receives assignment, status, and evidence events. Settings lets you choose which in-app events you receive.
tools.researchNote: Campaign suggestions currently use word overlap. Embeddings, HDBSCAN clustering, and automated fact-checking are not implemented.
tools.feedStale: The source could not be refreshed. Showing previously fetched articles.
tools.authEmailService: Authentication email API hook and approval notifications are implemented. Add server secrets, activate the Supabase Send Email Hook, and verify the sender domain before using SMTP2GO.

identity.kicker: An independent workspace for verified information
identity.description: Disinformation spreads fast. Bring the sources, evidence, and people together to build a response that holds up.
identity.principle: Every finding should lead back to its evidence.
identity.workspaceDesc: Move from an isolated link to a shared investigation, with the context kept intact.
identity.claimsDesc: Capture a claim, preserve its source, and follow its progress.
identity.evidenceDesc: Keep files, fingerprints, and supporting context together.
identity.campaignsDesc: Connect related claims and document the wider pattern.
identity.teamsDesc: Give each investigation a clear owner and a shared next step.
identity.howTitle: A process people can stand behind.

accounts.inviteNote: Sends a sign-in link using Supabase Auth and its configured email provider. New accounts still require admin approval.
accounts.deliveryNote: The mail service accepted the request. This is not a delivery receipt; check the provider activity log if it does not arrive.
accounts.noEmailSent: Creates an account without sending email or setting a shared password. The user can request a sign-in link or use a matching OAuth account.
accounts.addExisting: Add an existing user to this team
accounts.emailFailed: The decision was saved, but the email was not accepted.
accounts.smtpNote: Invitations and magic links use Supabase Auth. Choose the signed SMTP2GO API email hook or configure mail.smtp2go.com with SMTP credentials. The API key also powers approval notices. Server credential presence alone does not confirm delivery.
accounts.apiConfigured: SMTP2GO API credentials are present. This does not verify domain ownership, delivery, or the separate Supabase SMTP settings.
accounts.apiMissing: SMTP2GO_API_KEY or AUTH_EMAIL_FROM is missing from the Edge Function secrets.
accounts.requestInvite: Ask a team lead for an invitation to join.
